text:
maria: quick sync — Fluxion confirmed a joint perf run next week. goal: validate perf/W and 99th p99 latency for our LLM serving on their A100-like boards, and lock a kernel-tune that we can use in the marketplace listing.
jonah: +1. do we have target workloads? throughput vs single-stream latency?
maria: primary workloads — chat (streaming gen) and batch embeddings. target QPS for chat ~120 rps per card (8k token avg), embeddings 800 rps. perf/W is the headline metric (average watt over a 1h run).
lee_fluxion: Fluxion side: we'll expose power rails via IPMI and provide per-socket telemetry. we can also run our microkernel test harness. need the exact docker + env.
alyssa: can you share the harness image tag? we should standardize runtime flags so our telemetry aligns.
lee_fluxion: tag: fluxion/rdbench:2026-03-01, kernel-tune set: fxv2-lowlat. we'll drop a manifest shortly.
sara: marketing — heads up: if numbers look good we want a co-announcement cadence. can ops get a sanitized PR template? :sparkles:
maria: timeline: dry-run Wed 10am PT, full run Fri 9pm PT (to hit low-occupancy lab). can we confirm owners? jonah -- perf script + sigproc; lee_fluxion -- board telemetry + kernel-flash; alyssa -- infra + run orchestration; sara -- messaging. sound right?
jonah: assigned. i'll produce a perf script and a minimal repro. i'll push to repo under experiments/fluxion/ with a README.
jonah: sample perf command i'll use:
```
./run_perf --model redwood-13b --batch 4 --seq 8192 --streaming --duration 3600 --collect-kv --telemetry-endpoint http://collector.internal:8200
```
alyssa: infra notes — we'll run all workloads on dedicated nodes in the perf pool, isolated vSwitch, and use a single ingest gateway. collector will tag data with run_id and partner.
lee_fluxion: on kernel side, fxv2-lowlat has three knobs: prefetch=on, cta_threads=64, tensor-slicing=enabled. we'll provide a small script to flip them and reboot.
maria: telemetry schema must include: run_id, model, batch_size, seq_len, power_mean_w, power_p95_w, tokens_per_sec, latency_p50_ms, latency_p95_ms, kernel_version. please validate.
alyssa: noted. i'll produce the mapping and a small validation lambda that rejects incomplete payloads.
jonah: one gotcha — KV cache warmup skews perf/W. propose a 10-minute warmup phase in the run cadence; only measure last 50 minutes.
lee_fluxion: agree. we'll align power sampling to that window, 1s granularity.
sara: marketing ask — can we get per-model delta vs baseline (redwood hosted baseline) so we can call out % improvements?
maria: yes, we'll include baseline runs on our hosted infra earlier in the day.
jonah: quick config snippet for run_id generation and tags:
```
RUN_ID="fluxion-2026-03-18-01"
TAGS=("fluxion" "perf-W" "marketplace-tryout" "redwood-13b")
```
lee_fluxion: CC: deploy-bot — please create a lab booking for 2026-03-18 20:30 PT for 4 hours.
deploy-bot: lab booking created: lab-phi-3 reserved 2026-03-18T20:30:00-07:00 for 4h. booking_id=LB-83421
maria: thanks bot. next: risk list — thermal throttling, power sensor drift, network egress affecting streaming. mitigation owners?
lee_fluxion: thermal — fluxion lab will run throttling sim beforehand; i'll capture temp logs.
alyssa: network — we'll isolate and use a loopback ingest to remove egress variance.
jonah: power sensor drift — add a calibration step using a fixed-load generator at start. i'll script it.
sara: public-facing assets — timeline: numbers validated by Tue, draft co-blog by Thu, announce on Mon after legal review. i'll book a content review.
maria: action items: jonah -> perf scripts + baseline runs; lee_fluxion -> kernel scripts + telemetry manifest; alyssa -> collector mapping + infra; sara -> announcement plan + PR template. i'll follow up with a short runbook doc.
lee_fluxion: ping me in this thread when runbook is live; i'll do a preflight checklist.
maria: thanks everyone. posting runbook draft in experiments/fluxion/runbook.md in ~2h. :rocket:
